title: Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest
question:
Who has the highest average finishing rate between the highest and shortest football player?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: finishing rate refers to finishing; highest average finishing rate = MAX(AVG(finishing)); highest football player refers to MAX(height); shortest football player refers to MIN(height);

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_122 IN (
    SELECT p2.XCL_122
    FROM Player p2
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa2 ON p2.XCL_122 = pa2.XCL_130
    WHERE pa2.XCL_132 = (SELECT MAX(XCL_132) FROM Player_Attributes)
       OR pa2.XCL_132 = (SELECT MIN(XCL_132) FROM Player_Attributes)
)
GROUP BY p.XCL_122
ORDER BY AVG(pa.XCL_137) DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
WHERE p.XCL_126 BETWEEN (SELECT MIN(XCL_126) FROM Player WHERE XCL_126 IS NOT NULL)
                      AND (SELECT MAX(XCL_126) FROM Player WHERE XCL_126 IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY p.XCL_122, p.XCL_123
ORDER BY AVG(pa.XCL_138) DESC
LIMIT 1;
